2607.02963.title: Parallelized Autoregressive Decoding for Omni-Modal Dense Video Captioning
2607.02963.paper_summary: Dense video captioning aims to generate temporally grounded descriptions of video events, benefiting both event-level video understanding and generation. In this domain, autoregressive video large language models have emerged as a prevalent paradigm due to their strong generative and cross-modal modeling capacity. However, generating dense captions under the token-by-token paradigm severely limits inference efficiency and hinders scalability as video length and event density increase. In this work, we propose a parallelized autoregressive framework that not only improves generation efficiency but also enhances temporally grounded captioning performance. Our key insight is to exploit the weak local dependencies across temporally distinct events to restructure the causal dependency graph, thereby enabling lossless parallel generation. Specifically, tokens with weak cross-event dependencies can be decoded in parallel, while tightly coupled tokens within each event retain sequential decoding to preserve local semantic coherence. To realize this insight, we introduce two key components for lossless parallel decoding: (1) a latent global planning mechanism that automatically learns the event-level structure and produces compact tokens encoding global inter-event causality while adaptively aggregating event-level audio-visual semantics, guiding subsequent dependency restructuring and parallel decoding; and (2) an event-factorized parallel decoding mechanism that effectively balances local focus with global inter-event awareness. Experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate the clear advantage of our approach in both efficiency and performance in omni-modal event grounding and captioning. Project website: https://github.com/showlab/PadCaptioner.
2607.02963.paper_summary_zh: 密集視頻標註旨在生成與視頻事件時間上相關的描述，這對於事件層級的視頻理解和生成都有所裨益。在這個領域，自回歸視頻大型語言模型已經成為一種普遍的範式，因為它們具有強大的生成和跨模態建模能力。然而，在逐個標記的範式下生成密集標註會嚴重限制推理效率，並隨著視頻長度和事件密度的增加而妨礙可擴展性。在這項工作中，我們提出了一個平行自回歸框架，不僅提高了生成效率，還增強了時間上相關的標註性能。我們的關鍵見解是利用時間上不同事件之間的弱局部依賴性來重構因果依賴圖，從而實現無損的平行生成。具體而言，具有弱跨事件依賴性的標記可以平行解碼，而每個事件內部緊密耦合的標記則保持順序解碼，以保留局部語義的一致性。為了實現這一見解，我們引入了兩個無損平行解碼的關鍵組件：(1) 一個潛在的全局規劃機制，能自動學習事件層級結構並生成編碼全局事件間因果關係的緊湊標記，同時自適應聚合事件層級的視聽語義，指導後續的依賴重構和平行解碼；(2) 一個事件因子化的平行解碼機制，有效平衡局部專注與全局事件間的意識。各種基準上的實驗顯示，我們的方法在效率和性能上在全模態事件定位和標註中具有明顯的優勢。項目網站：https://github.com/showlab/PadCaptioner。
